history.summary: Freehold 689 sqft 1BR in D13 (Potong Pasir/Woodleigh fringe) with a striking -28.7% age-adjusted discount, but the value signal is unverifiable — psf_cohort_txns is null/0 and appreciation is regional_baseline, and comparable Maisons-series projects actually transact at $1,499-1,754 psf, so the $1,361 asking may be cheap or may be a name/comp-matching artifact.
history.rating_rationale: The headline -28.7% discount is unsupported by real data: psf_cohort_txns is null/0 and appreciation_source is regional_baseline (0 txns), so the algo never measured a true comp. Adjacent Maisons-series freehold projects (R Maison at Sommerville Walk ~$1,514 psf; E Maisons The Maisons on Braddell Rd $1,499-1,754 psf) trade above the $1,361 asking, which is mildly supportive of cheapness — but I could not confirm the exact project's own recent transactions, and the -28.7% figure looks too large to be a clean read. D13 RCR location near Woodleigh/Potong Pasir MRT and the Bidadari estate is a genuine support. Per v3.4, value must lead and FH is not an edge; with value unverified this is Neutral at low confidence pending real same-project comps.
